title: Create a read-only live Terraform plan for the ECR signer foundation
expected_outcome: A saved, non-sensitive read-only Terraform plan evaluates only the ECR signer foundation enablement against the approved remote state, or records an evidence-backed access/configuration blocker.
constraints: Run only AWS identity/state/provider read operations and Terraform init/plan with locking disabled. Do not apply, refresh state writes, create ECR resources, mirror images, change GitHub environments, access Vault/EKS, or alter secrets.
Use an ephemeral non-secret tfvars file outside the repository and do not persist credentials, backend configuration, or plan output in Git.

external_actions: read approved S3 Terraform backend and DynamoDB lock metadata as required by Terraform init
read AWS provider data during Terraform plan

primary_owner.responsibility: live-plan safety boundary, result review, and final integration

acceptance_checks: safe command and live input map
delegations.escalation_trigger: live credentials or backend mutation would be needed
